Theme

Latin word

plānē

adverb · Wiktionary

plainly, clearly, so as to be understood; quite, completely, entirely; yes, exactly so

In this lexicon

  • clearly

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. de Or. 1.144: deinde ut plānē et dīlūcidē; Cic. Phil. 7.17: quī plānē et Latīnē loquuntur

  • quite

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Att. 13.6.2: plānē bene, “quite right”; Cic. Att. 12.37.1: plānē bellē sē habēre; Phaedr. 3.7.26: nōn plānē est; Traupman 107: I simply don’t know what he is thinking of, jam plānē quid cōgitet nesciō

  • simply

    also used · classical · Cic. Phil. 7.17: quī plānē et Latīnē loquuntur; Cic. de Or. 2.303: ut plānius dīcam

  • yes

    also used · classical · Plaut. Truc. 2.7.57: Plānē istuc est. (Lewis & Short); Traupman 250

  • plānē et Latīnē loquī: speak plainly

    classical
